text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ is a racer who loves
formulating theories on how
events will
play out. But sometimes, pure chance
dictates the
outcome—much like our
chance meeting.

One day, while walking behind the
school...

Something falls from above. It glitters in
the light, reflecting the
setting sun.
I'm so sorry! You're not hurt, are you?

I hear a sharp, clear voice overhead.
Looking up, there's an
Umamusume poking
out from a classroom window.

Yes! My apologies—I was lost in thought,
and they must've fallen off.
choice_data_list: No problem, I'll bring them up to you!

text_block_list.text: You will? That'd be much appreciated!

I carry the glasses up to the classroom
where the student is waiting.

Good... The hinges move without issue.
And the lenses appear to be
unblemished.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
These are tailor-made for racing.
Naturally, their material is able to

withstand quite a bit of wear and tear.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Meaning, in theory, the fall from only a
second-story window should
not damage
them.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
However, the possibility remained that a
runner might inadvertently
trample them.
Your assistance, though, reduced that
chance to zero.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You have my thanks. Now I will not be
hindered tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Well, with that badge on your collar, I
suspect you're a trainer. Then
I'm sure you
are well aware of the tryouts tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That's where Umamusume aiming to debut
will exhibit their abilities
to trainers in the
hopes of being scouted.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And in the tenth race, I—Biwa
Hayahide—will be participating.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Rather, I must participate. There is something I have to accomplish in the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
So, needless to say, I will seize this
opportunity for victory—and my
chance to
make my debut.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Although she speaks calmly, I feel her
unwavering confidence, her
eyes
smoldering with iron will.
I suppose... I can reveal one thing.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
In tomorrow's race, I'll stay near the lead
until the final corner. The
front pack will
be tightly grouped together.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Following the last turn, I'll pass them from
outside.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Then I will gain a lead of no less than ten
lengths—and place first.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That is the result I've derived from my
calculations. Whether it proves
true or
not... you should confirm tomorrow with
your own eyes.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's calculations are both
composed and daring at the
same time.
But will the outcome really be as she
predicts?

Having grown curious, I come to see the
tryouts the next day to see
how her races
pan out.

The racers are in a heated battle right out
of the gate! The spotlight's
on Biwa
Hayahide, who's gotten a favorable
position in the front!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: All according to my predictions.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The front pack is heading into the third
corner! It's a close fight
between the
leaders!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Three... two... one.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Time to confirm my calculations!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
They're out of the corner and into the final
straight! Бива Хаяхидэ
comes in from the
outside! Бива Хаяхидэ takes the lead!
She's two
lengths ahead! Now three!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
And Бива Хаяхидэ places first! She wins it
by a landslide! What an
overwhelming
victory!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
I feel a chill run down my spine as I watch
Biwa Hayahide's prediction
play out word
for word!

Wow, that was some show, Бива Хаяхидэ!
You had plenty to
spare—almost like you
had it all planned out.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text: Hm? Hey, look! Is that who I think it is?!
text_block_list.name: New Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Such formidable abilities should be getting
Biwa Hayahide scouting
requests from all
sides. But suddenly, an unexpected visitor
arrives...
Nice run.
Oh, it's you, Brian. Here to spectate?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I was just passing by.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I knew it! It's the Beast, Нарита Брайан! I've
heard she's pretty elusive,
but here she
is—right in front of me!
text_block_list.name: New Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Holy hotcakes, what am I waitin' for! Brian!
I'd love to have a talk!
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text: Tch, the rats are squeaking... Later, Sis.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
One moment, Brian. You appear... thinner
than usual.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Are you not meeting your dietary
requirements? Is your nutritional
intake
sufficient?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Lay off of me. I'm eating just fine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hm. I think I understand. The recent
changes to the cafeteria menu
are not to
your liking.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You've always been far too picky an eater.
Listen, our energy
consumption is
exceptional, and—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Ugh! You're so bigheaded about
everything!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What?! M-my head is NOT large! To the
contrary, it is of average
proportions...
Brian!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Goodness... She can be so stubborn.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Wait up, Brian! The Triple Crown sure
would look glorious on you!
And I can help
you get it!
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text: There is still room to improve my theories.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It turns out that Бива Хаяхидэ, who runs
with calculated precision, is
also the older
sister of the racer dubbed the "Beast."

Strangely, I find myself drawn to her. I feel
a growing curiosity within
me, wanting to
know more about this intriguing runner.
